class.name: FmodParameterDescription
class.brief_description: Describes the properties and constraints of an FMOD Studio event parameter.
class.description:
FmodParameterDescription contains the metadata for a single FMOD Studio event parameter — its name, ID, value range, default value, and behavioral flags.
Obtain descriptions via [FmodEventDescription]: [codeblock] var desc = FmodServer.get_event("event:/SFX/Explosion") var param = desc.get_parameter_by_name("Size") print(param.get_minimum(), " to ", param.get_maximum()) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_default_value
method.description: Returns the default value of the parameter as set in FMOD Studio.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the numerical ID of the parameter. Use this with the [code]_by_id[/code] variants on [FmodEvent] and [FmodEventDescription] for faster access than name-based lookups.

method.name: get_maximum
method.description: Returns the maximum valid value for this parameter.

method.name: get_minimum
method.description: Returns the minimum valid value for this parameter.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the name of the parameter as defined in FMOD Studio.

method.name: is_automatic
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if FMOD controls this parameter automatically (e.g. distance, direction). Automatic parameters cannot be set manually.

method.name: is_discrete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the parameter only accepts integer (stepped) values rather than a continuous range.

method.name: is_global
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the parameter is global — shared across all instances of the event rather than per-instance.

method.name: is_labeled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the parameter is a labeled enum. Use [method FmodEventDescription.get_parameter_labels_by_name] to retrieve the labels.

method.name: is_read_only
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the parameter is read-only and cannot be modified at runtime.
